{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Hex Drako''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and an above average speed, however, it had 100% defense, reducing most forms of damage by half. It also had [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]]. ==Appearance== The Hex Drako had pale maroon skin, neon yellow eyes and a long neck. It wore brown pants and shirt, grey shoulder-pads, arm-bands, shoes and chestplate, and a white skull with horns. Multiple spikes could be seen on its armor and it had a red crystal on its mask. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]], can be quite effective against this. *As it has quite high defense, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[DJ Booth]] can allow your towers to deal more damage to it. **Freeze defense dropping towers cannot drop its defense, as it has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight3Thumbnail.png|'''Hex Drako''' on the game thumbnail.
